abstract: OBJECTIVE: The aim of this study was to investigate the outcome and reproductive function of patients with ovarian endodermal sinus tumor (EST) after cumulative high-dose combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin (BEP). METHODS: Between 1995 and 2006, 1034 patients with the diagnosis of ovarian cancer were treated at a single institution. Among these patients, 51 had a confirmed diagnosis of malignant ovarian germ cell tumor (MOGCT) including 20 cases of EST. We retrospectively reviewed those patients with EST, who received BEP as adjuvant chemotherapy. The doses were 15 mg/day of bleomycin on days 1 to 3, 100 mg/m(2)/day IV of etoposide on days 1 to 3 and 20 mg/m(2)/day of cisplatin on days 1 to 5. The median number of total cycles was six (range between three and nine). RESULTS: The median age of the patients with EST was 18 years (range 5 to 36). All except two were nulliparous. The overall survival rate was 90% at a median follow-up of 70 months. Two patients (10%) had disease recurrence in the pelvis. Of the 15 patients who were treated with fertility-sparing surgery, all had regular menstruation following the completion of adjuvant chemotherapy, and two of these patients had pregnancies with live birth deliveries and no complications. CONCLUSION: In patients with EST, the cumulative high-dose BEP regimen resulted in excellent overall survival and did not seem to impair ovarian function.
abstract_ja:
目的: 累積高用量のブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン（BEP）併用化学療法を施行された卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍（EST）患者の転帰と生殖機能を検討すること。
方法: 1995年から2006年の間に、単一施設で卵巣癌と診断された1034例を治療した。そのうち51例が悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍（MOGCT）と確定診断され、20例が卵黄嚢腫瘍であった。補助化学療法としてBEPを施行された卵黄嚢腫瘍の患者を後方視的に検討した。投与量は、ブレオマイシン15 mg/日を1〜3日目、エトポシド100 mg/m²/日を1〜3日目、シスプラチン20 mg/m²/日を1〜5日目に静脈内投与した。総コース数の中央値は6コース（範囲3〜9）であった。
結果: 卵黄嚢腫瘍患者の年齢中央値は18歳（範囲5〜36歳）。2例を除き全員が未経産であった。中央値70か月の追跡で全生存率は90%であった。2例（10%）が骨盤内に再発した。妊孕性温存手術を受けた15例は、いずれも補助化学療法後に規則的な月経が回復し、そのうち2例は妊娠して生児を出産し、合併症はなかった。
結論: 卵黄嚢腫瘍患者では、累積高用量BEPレジメンにより優れた全生存率が得られ、卵巣機能を損なわないようであった。
